input.query: SELECT variant, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS conv_rate, AVG(margin_60d_eur) AS avg_margin_60d_eur, AVG(bonus_cost_eur) AS avg_bonus_cost_eur, SUM(bonus_cost_eur) AS total_bonus_cost_eur FROM fct_experiment_users WHERE experiment_id = 'topup10_2026q1' GROUP BY variant ORDER BY variant
